backendObservation.note: Those concurrent backend edits belong to root/other work and were not touched by this reviewer. The source scaffold commit remains historical, not proof of the concurrently modified current tree.

positiveDesignObservations: Native and owner-snapshot demand is normalized into actual typed demand rows; forecast, candidate, solver run, immutable evaluation, Approval request and publication ledger are physically separated.
Revision family/candidate/evaluation allocators are separate from aggregate CAS version; tenant-local FK/unique constraints and cross-candidate pointer defense are explicitly proposed.
Forecast revision creates a new DRAFT public UUID and preserves the PUBLISHED/CANCELLED source aggregate; no NEW_DRAFT pseudo source-state edge.
Candidate QUEUED and solver-run RUNNING are separate, lease-claim is owner workload only; completion is not a public arbitrary success API.

Generic SUBMITTED cancel is excluded; exact owner cancellation receipt is required for withdrawal; publish rechecks authorization/input/Approval and declares one TIM transaction for canonical schedule+ledger+outbox+receipt.
Exact WORK/BREAK intervals, paidness, localWorkDate, IANA zone, both offsets, tzdbVersion, calendar/work-rule refs are stored and projected; aggregate break duration is only owner-derived.
Current real G2 receipt status enum exactly matches declared ACCEPTED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/REJECTED/FAILED/RESULT_UNKNOWN, and receipt/outbox field names referenced directly are real columns.
All 65 direct query projection columns exist in proposed physical columns or real G2 receipt SQL; all 18 local/deferred FK edges have existing tenant-composite columns and exact unique targets.
Task/detail/tab UX is separated from API count; DesignAI package belongs to G5 after functionality. This is consistent with the user's phased design replacement request.
Three imported schema IDs exist in the pinned PER/SYS proposal documents, but existence does not publish owner DTO/SPI authority.

findings.title: 만료된 RUNNING lease를 RESULT_UNKNOWN으로 fence할 수 없음
findings.why: lease-claim은 expired external execution을 RESULT_UNKNOWN/reconcile로 처리하라고 하나 mark-unknown은 unexpired exact lease를 요구한다. owner-clock이 lease_expires_at을 지난 최초 시점에는 선언한 UNKNOWN 경로가 실행 불가능하다.
findings.repair: verified owner watchdog의 timeout→UNKNOWN 전이를 completion/failure의 live-lease 조건과 분리한다. 정확 current run/lease/candidate/input/cancel fence CAS로 실행하고 old delivery를 fence한다. lease 만료 자체를 안전한 신규 dispatch로 해석하지 않는다.

findings.why: shift.requiredSkills는 solver가 보낸 verified shift 필드에서만 저장되고 absent/empty이면 skill 요구가 없다고 정의된다. demandLineKey FK는 수요행 존재만 증명한다. frozen demand.required_skills의 권위/equality, planning snapshot의 worker+assignment membership, forecast worksite binding은 exact guard/source graph에 없다. 구현 취약점이 이미 실행됐다는 주장이 아니라 검증 전 설계의 중대한 미정 경계다.
